title: Anheuser-Busch has 2 Fastest-Growing Beers in U.S.: Michelob ULTRA & Busch Light
summary: Michelob ULTRA just posted its best quarter in brand’s history and Busch Light reaches a new all-time high market share
body_markdown:
**Key Facts:**


• Busch Light is celebrating the 20th anniversary of its Hunting Cans with limited-edition retro-inspired packaging, available nationwide beginning September 29, 2026, while supplies last.


• Fans 21+ can enter, via @[buschbeer,](https://www.instagram.com/buschbeer/) the Busch Taxidermy Canimal Sweepstakes from September 29 through October 23 for a chance to win custom "Canimal Taxidermy Trophies."


• To commemorate the release, Busch Light will donate $50,000 to Ducks Unlimited, marking the brand's sixth consecutive year supporting the nonprofit organization’s efforts to preserve and protect our beloved natural surroundings.


**St. Louis, MO – September 29, 2026 –** This fall, Busch Light, the #2 fastest-growing beer in America¹, is heading back into the woods and duck blinds to celebrate a major milestone: the 20th anniversary of its fan-favorite Hunting Cans.


After 20 years celebrating the hunt, Busch Light is rolling out its most iconic limited-edition Hunting Cans yet—featuring a retro-inspired design that honors two decades of outdoor tradition. Available nationwide starting September 29 at participating retailers in 12-pack, 18-pack, 24-pack, and 30-pack 12oz cans while supplies last. These special cans are the perfect complement to any post-hunt celebration.


**Krystyn Stowe, Head of Marketing, Busch Family & Natural Family at Anheuser-Busch** said: "For 20 years, Busch Light has shown up for hunters who live for the outdoors and the traditions that come with it. As we celebrate this milestone, our limited-edition Hunting Cans celebrate that shared passion and the post‑hunting moments best enjoyed with a cold and smooth Busch Light.”


**Introducing the Busch Light "Canimal" Trophy & Busch Light Camo Beer Deer**


To mark two decades as an essential part of hunting season, Busch Light is ensuring fewer hunters go home empty-handed, even if they come up short in the field. Through the national Busch Taxidermy Canimal Sweepstakes, lucky fans can win custom “Canimal Taxidermy Trophies”: wildly detailed, one-of-a-kind mounts handcrafted from Busch Light cans and transformed into iconic hunting trophies, including a duck, deer and hog. Part trophy, part beer art, 100% Busch Light -- the ultimate bragging-rights for the hunter who loves the season as much as the score. Starting September 29 through October 23, beer lovers and outdoor enthusiasts 21+ can enter via[@buschbeer](https://www.instagram.com/BuschBeer/) social channels for a chance to win their very own Canimal Taxidermy Trophy*.


For those who may not have won and to give more hunters the chance to enjoy a new trophy this season, there will be another sweepstakes on Busch Light social channels, available later in October, to win a special Officially Licensed Busch Light Camo Beer Deer wall mount**. Fans can also purchase their own limited-edition Camo Busch Light Deer at[BeerDeerUSA.com](https://beerdeerusa.com/pages/busch-light-camo-promo-page) .


Additionally, 2026 marks the brand's sixth year of partnership with Ducks Unlimited, a leading global nonprofit organization. In honor of the specialty Hunting Cans release, Busch Light will donate $50,000 to Ducks Unlimited to support its efforts to preserve and protect our beloved natural surroundings.


For more information on Busch Light Hunting Cans, the Canimal Sweepstakes, and official rules, visit[www.busch.com](https://www.busch.com/) and follow Busch Light on[X](https://x.com/BuschBeer) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/Busch) , and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/buschbeer/) .
